zh-Hant.title: 剛複製的，點一下就貼上
zh-Hant.body: 剛複製的內容會出現在鍵盤上方，點一下就貼上。右側的剪貼簿按鈕可以存地址、電話、Email、身分證字號，一點就輸入，全部只存在手機上。注音會記得你選過的字，選完還會建議下一個詞。
zh-Hant.also: 語音潤飾多了「精簡」，不滿意可「換回原文」；語音紀錄可以「修正這個詞」；長按空白鍵移動游標。

en.title: Paste what you just copied in one tap
en.body: Whatever you just copied appears above the keys; tap to paste it. The clipboard button on the right keeps addresses, phone numbers, email and your ID number one tap away, all on your phone. Bopomofo remembers the words you pick and suggests what comes next.
en.also: Voice typing gains a Concise style and Use original; fix a misheard word from your history; hold the space bar to move the cursor.
